name: gaffer_context
description: Bounded read of the attached Gaffer script: script_handle, revision, the file, selection, focus, and node cards (ref, name, type, plugs; values and connections with include). refs, match (glob on name and type) and radius pick the nodes; without them, the selection, focus and recent nodes. Call first; pass revision to gaffer_apply. quarantined: changes wait until release_quarantine with this read's revision.

refs.description: Up to 50 node or plug refs.

radius.description: Neighbours of the picked nodes, 0 to 2.

plugs.description: Plug names to read on the picked nodes.

recipe_match.description: {id?, node_type?, menu_path?, variant?}: the node menu's recipes (with include recipes).

job.description: {id, after?, limit?}: a render job started by gaffer_apply render.start.

include.description: values, connections, schema, affordances, capabilities, recipes, renders.

if_revision.description: The changes since that revision, when the journal still holds them.

release_quarantine.description: After a failed change that could not be proven undone: the revision of the read that showed the script, once you checked it; lifts the quarantine.
